language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language you'd like to use Yelen in.

recovery.title: Recover my account
recovery.subtitle: Lost or changed phone number, or can't access two-factor authentication? An admin will verify your ID and approve the request.
recovery.totpNotice: Your number stays the same. Once approved, two-factor authentication will be disabled — you'll be able to sign in with just the SMS code, and turn it back on later if needed.

errors.samePhone: The new number must be different from the old one.
errors.nameRequired: Enter your first and last name.
errors.sendFailed: Something went wrong sending your request. Please try again.

recovery.disclaimer: Your ID document is sent securely and only reviewed by the Yelen team to verify your request.

success.title: Request sent
success.bodyNumero: A member of the Yelen team will review your ID document. Once the request is approved, a {hours}-hour security delay applies before the new number is activated — giving you time to contact us if this request wasn't made by you.
success.bodyTotp: A member of the Yelen team will review your ID document. Once the request is approved, a {hours}-hour security delay applies before two-factor authentication is disabled — giving you time to contact us if this request wasn't made by you.
